title: Provocation recruits a crowd
mechanism_summary: A troll posts comments designed to upset a target and encourages others to join. The attack expands into a pile-on rather than a genuine discussion.
suggested_beats: Others are urged to join the attack.
Report abuse rather than amplifying it.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone participating in an online discussion
why_it_works: Crowd participation can make harassment feel socially rewarded.

title: A disagreement becomes an identity-based attack
mechanism_summary: An online troll targets personal characteristics to humiliate someone. The abuse shifts attention away from the discussion and toward punishing the person.
suggested_beats: A public discussion attracts a troll.
why_it_works: Prejudice and public humiliation can pressure someone out of a conversation.

title: Private details invite a wave of unwanted contact
mechanism_summary: Someone publishes another person's contact or location information to cause harm. Others are encouraged to use it to harass the target.
suggested_beats: Report the disclosure without reposting the details.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone whose private information is exposed
why_it_works: Publicly supplied details lower the effort needed for others to join abuse.

title: Sensitive records are published to undermine credibility
mechanism_summary: An attacker exposes private medical, financial, or personal material. The disclosure is intended to damage the person's reputation or standing.
suggested_beats: It is published to discredit someone.
Preserve evidence and seek removal support.
why_it_works: Embarrassment and reputational fear give private information coercive value.

title: Rumors turn a social feed into a hostile space
mechanism_summary: Someone circulates lies about a person online. Repetition and sharing can expand the harm beyond the original audience.
suggested_beats: Document and report the harmful posts.
why_it_works: Repetition can make an unsupported accusation seem credible.

title: A humiliating recording outlives the original incident
mechanism_summary: A recording of an embarrassing incident is shared online to humiliate someone. Wider circulation prolongs the person's distress beyond the event itself.
suggested_beats: The recording is shared for ridicule.
Support the target and report abusive sharing.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone whose embarrassing recording is circulated
why_it_works: Audience attention rewards forwarding while hiding its impact on the person shown.

title: Abusive messages attack a person's differences
mechanism_summary: A young person receives repeated messages insulting their personal differences. The repeated insults make online participation distressing and isolating.
suggested_beats: Tell a trusted adult and report the abuse.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a young person receiving targeted insults
why_it_works: Repeated rejection can exploit a person's need for acceptance.

title: Reputation attacks push a public participant into silence
mechanism_summary: A person with a public online presence receives comments intended to damage their reputation. The abuse can cause withdrawal or self-censorship.
suggested_beats: Seek support and document the harmful conduct.
why_it_works: Reputational pressure can make continued participation feel personally costly.
